On November 23, 2026, Arcus Biosciences, Inc. (“Arcus”) announced the discontinuation of the Phase 3 PRISM-1 clinical study as a result of not reaching the pre-specified efficacy boundary for overall survival (“OS”), the study’s primary endpoint. PRISM-1 evaluated quemliclustat plus gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel chemotherapy versus placebo plus gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel chemotherapy in patients with treatment-naïve metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). The decision is based on the recommendation from the Independent Data Monitoring Committee following its review of data from an event-driven, pre-specified interim analysis of OS. At the interim analysis, the quemliclustat regimen showed similar efficacy for the primary and secondary endpoints compared with gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel alone. There were no differences in adverse events or toxicity.
